zh.title: 航空短訊彙整：杜勒斯機場逾200億美元改造計畫，聯合航空樞紐航廈將汰換；西南航空組員機上爭執致班機延誤逾兩小時，一人傳已辭職
zh.summary: 本期收錄4則獨立消息：杜勒斯機場逾200億美元改造計畫，聯合航空樞紐航廈將汰換、西南航空組員機上爭執致班機延誤逾兩小時，一人傳已辭職、星航斥資20億新元推出新一代長程客艙，2027年下半年起陸續上線。
body: 本期彙整4則航空短訊，各則為獨立事件。部分內容摘自近期站內報導，原文與來源見文末。

1. 杜勒斯機場逾200億美元改造計畫，聯合航空樞紐航廈將汰換
華盛頓杜勒斯機場（IAD）宣布逾200億美元十年改造計畫，E航廈將於2026年稍晚啟用，C、D航廈將汰換，沙里寧主航廈則保留。

2. 西南航空組員機上爭執致班機延誤逾兩小時，一人傳已辭職
西南航空557號班機兩名組員在已登機的客機上發生口角，班機延誤2小時24分；據報導，其中一名組員事後已辭職。

3. 星航斥資20億新元推出新一代長程客艙，2027年下半年起陸續上線
新加坡航空宣布投資20億新加坡元（約15.6億美元）推出全新頭等、商務、豪華經濟與經濟長程客艙，自2027年下半年起陸續裝上41架改裝A350-900與A350-900ULR及新引進的777-9機隊；頭等艙中央座位可併成號稱「天空最大雙人床」。

4. 澳航出售44架737NG予AerFin，為退役主力機隊鋪路
澳航將44架波音737NG售予AerFin，包含88具CFM56-7B發動機，創下AerFin史上最大交易；移交將歷時七年，A321XLR將接替退役的737機隊。

en.title: Aviation briefs: Dulles (IAD) airport unveils $20 billion transformation plan around United hub; Southwest crew dispute delays flight over two hours; attendant reportedly quits
en.summary: 4 independent updates: Dulles airport unveils $20 billion transformation plan around United hub; Southwest crew dispute delays flight over two hours; attendant reportedly quits; Singapore Airlines unveils next-generation long-haul cabins in S$2 billion investment.
body: 4 independent aviation updates. Includes excerpts of recent reports, with original reports and sources linked below.

1. Dulles (IAD) airport unveils $20 billion transformation plan around United hub
Washington Dulles International Airport has unveiled a capital program of more than $20 billion over the next decade, with Concourse E opening later in 2026 and Concourses C and D slated for replacement while Eero Saarinen’s Main Terminal is preserved.

2. Southwest crew dispute delays flight over two hours; attendant reportedly quits
Two Southwest Airlines flight attendants argued in front of a fully boarded aircraft, delaying flight 557 by two hours and 24 minutes; one of the attendants has reportedly since quit.

3. Singapore Airlines unveils next-generation long-haul cabins in S$2 billion investment
Singapore Airlines has announced a S$2 billion ($1.56 billion) investment in new first, business, premium economy and economy long-haul products, to be progressively introduced from the second half of 2027 on 41 retrofitted Airbus A350-900 and A350-900ULR aircraft and its upcoming Boeing 777-9 fleet; first-class centre seats can convert into what SIA calls the 'largest double bed in the sky'.

4. Qantas sells 44 Boeing 737NGs to AerFin as it plans retirement of its workhorse fleet
Qantas has sold 44 Boeing 737NGs, including 88 CFM56-7B engines, to AerFin in the aftermarket specialist's largest deal, with the transfer spread over seven years as A321XLRs replace the 737 fleet.
